title: A Autopsy for the Portrait Again
author: Wendell Yarrow
blurb: Felix Reyes, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
